division.heading: Actions Started by Statement of Claim

operative_text.controlling:
3.57   A counterclaim must
(a) be in Form 21,
(b) comply with the rules about pleadings in Part 13, Division
3, and
(c) be filed and served on the defendant-by-counterclaim
within the same time period that the plaintiff-by-
counterclaim must file a statement of defence under rule
3.31(2).

commentary.text:
Rule 3.57 requires a counterclaim to be filed within the same period as a statement of defence. Thus, a defendant will typically file its statement of defence and counterclaim, if any, at the same time — although they could be filed on separate dates, as long as both are within the required time.
